title.narrative: Entrepreneurship Curriculum Programme in general and technical secondary education of Cape Verde

description.narrative: This project contributes to the process of curriculum transformation for general and technical secondary education by the Government of Cape Verde with the objective to create an education system that links both, theoretical and practical learning, thereby attending social and economic needs of the country. The project will provide technical support to the Ministry of Education and Sports (MED) endeavor to introduce the subject of entrepreneurship in general and technical secondary education, in order to instill a positive attitude in youths towards entrepreneurship and business, foster their creativity, innovation and self-confidence, develop an entrepreneurial culture and skills with a view to strengthen the entrepreneurial foundation that enables a dynamic private sector in Cape Verde. The project will assist in the preparation of entrepreneurship teaching and training material, of monitoring and evaluation tools, assessment guidelines as well as in the training of teachers, the preparation and implementation of a pilot experience in 10 schools, reaching about 64 classes with about 3,500 trained students and 100 qualified teachers and lastly the establishment of a strategy for the nation-wide rollout.
